import argparse, json
from pathlib import Path
p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument("--out", required=True, type=Path)
p.add_argument("files", nargs="+", type=Path)
a = p.parse_args()
cases, traces, controls = [], [], []
for path in a.files:
    case = None
    with path.open() as stream:
        for line in stream:
            if not any(k in line for k in ("\"record\":\"case\"", "\"record\":\"verified\"", "\"record\":\"missing_coverage_control\"", "\"record\":\"conditional_image_model\"")):
                continue
            r = json.loads(line)
            if r["record"] == "case":
                case = r["id"]
                cases.append({k: r[k] for k in ("id", "p", "width", "accuracy", "derived_inputs", "argument_product_degree", "selected_first_variable")} | {"true_arguments": r.get("true_arguments", False), "input": str(path)})
            elif r["record"] == "verified":
                traces.append({"case": case, "input": str(path), **r})
            else:
                controls.append({"input": str(path), **r})
report = {"schema": 1, "cases": cases, "traces": traces, "controls": controls}
with a.out.open("x") as stream:
    json.dump(report, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write("\n")
print(len(cases), "cases,", len(traces), "complete PC traces,", len(controls), "controls")
